slides.headline: Get these 5 ready before you list
slides.body: Sellers who prepare early avoid delays after the offer. Save this.

slides.headline: Your building plans
slides.body: Approved plans for the house and any additions. Can't find them? Start looking now.

slides.headline: Compliance certificates
slides.body: Your attorney will ask for them, like the electrical certificate. Book the inspections early.

slides.headline: Your bond details
slides.body: Ask your bank what it needs to cancel your bond, and how much notice it wants.

slides.headline: A list of what stays
slides.body: Curtains, light fittings, the pool pump. Decide now so every offer is clear.

slides.headline: The small repairs
slides.body: Dripping taps, loose handles, cracked tiles. Fix them before the photos.

slides.headline: Know your number first
slides.body: A free market analysis of your home, plus my get-your-home-ready checklist.
